$comment: Ownership manifest for the Ferst thin-client. `upstream` is where scaffold updates come from (this template); `ownedPaths` are TEMPLATE-owned (synced from upstream by `npm run update` / `ferst-update`, never hand-edited in a client); `clientPaths` are the client's own data (never touched by an update); `coreRange` is the ferst-core version this scaffold targets. See docs/UPDATING.md and CLAUDE.md.
